☸️ Cluster Environments

Deploy on Kind, K3s, Minikube & Kubeadm

Production-grade eBPF CNI and Gateway API networking on local engines and bare-metal nodes. Step-by-step setup guides, cluster initialization manifests, and verified Helm deployment flags.

💡
Kind Dataplane Architecture Invariant
Kind clusters require disabling kindnet (disableDefaultCNI: true), disabling kube-proxy (kubeProxyMode: "none"), and mounting the host's /sys/fs/bpf filesystem into container nodes with bidirectional mount propagation so StraitKubeGateway's straitd node agent can pin eBPF maps.
1 Create Kind Cluster Config & Bootstrap 
cat <<'EOF' > kind-config.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
networking:
  disableDefaultCNI: true
  kubeProxyMode: "none"
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
    extraMounts:
      - hostPath: /sys/fs/bpf
        containerPath: /sys/fs/bpf
        propagation: Bidirectional
  - role: worker
    extraMounts:
      - hostPath: /sys/fs/bpf
        containerPath: /sys/fs/bpf
        propagation: Bidirectional
EOF
kind create cluster --name straitkubegateway --config kind-config.yaml
2 Apply Gateway API v1.6.1 CRDs 
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f \
  https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.6.1/standard-install.yaml
3 Install StraitKubeGateway via Helm 
helm repo add straitkubegateway https://msaeedb40.github.io/straitKubegateway
helm repo update

helm install straitkubegateway straitkubegateway/straitkubegateway \
  --namespace kube-system \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyReplacement=true \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyMode=none \
  --set straitd.image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
  --set sgController.image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
  --wait --timeout 300s
4 Verify Node Status & Dataplane 
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready nodes --all --timeout=120s
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app.kubernetes.io/name=straitkubegateway -o wide
kubectl get gatewayclasses,gateways,straitnetworks
💡
K3s Dataplane Architecture Invariant
K3s by default packages Flannel and its own kube-proxy. When running via k3d, pass --flannel-backend=none, --disable-kube-proxy, --disable=traefik, --disable=servicelb, and mount /sys/fs/bpf into all server and agent nodes so that StraitKubeGateway handles all VIP translation and CNI routing in eBPF.
1 Create K3s Cluster via k3d 
k3d cluster create straitkubegateway \
  --servers 1 \
  --agents 2 \
  --k3s-arg "--flannel-backend=none@server:*" \
  --k3s-arg "--disable-network-policy@server:*" \
  --k3s-arg "--disable=traefik@server:*" \
  --k3s-arg "--disable=servicelb@server:*" \
  --k3s-arg "--disable-kube-proxy@server:*" \
  --volume /sys/fs/bpf:/sys/fs/bpf@server:*;agent:* \
  --no-lb \
  --wait
2 Apply Gateway API v1.6.1 CRDs 
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f \
  https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.6.1/standard-install.yaml
3 Install StraitKubeGateway via Helm 
helm repo add straitkubegateway https://msaeedb40.github.io/straitKubegateway
helm repo update

helm install straitkubegateway straitkubegateway/straitkubegateway \
  --namespace kube-system \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyReplacement=true \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyMode=none \
  --set straitd.image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
  --set sgController.image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
  --wait --timeout 300s
4 Verify Node Status & Dataplane 
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready nodes --all --timeout=120s
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app.kubernetes.io/name=straitkubegateway -o wide
kubectl get gatewayclasses,gateways,straitnetworks
💡
Minikube Dataplane Architecture Invariant
Minikube clusters must be initialized with --cni=false and --extra-config=kubeadm.skip-phases=addon/kube-proxy so that kubeadm does not deploy kindnet/bridge CNI or iptables kube-proxy. StraitKubeGateway will schedule onto the uninitialized nodes, initialize NetKit/veth interfaces, and set nodes to Ready.
1 Start Minikube with CNI & Kube-Proxy Disabled 
minikube start \
  --driver=docker \
  --nodes=2 \
  --cni=false \
  --extra-config=kubeadm.skip-phases=addon/kube-proxy \
  --cpus=2 \
  --memory=4096m
2 Apply Gateway API v1.6.1 CRDs 
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f \
  https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.6.1/standard-install.yaml
3 Install StraitKubeGateway via Helm 
helm repo add straitkubegateway https://msaeedb40.github.io/straitKubegateway
helm repo update

helm install straitkubegateway straitkubegateway/straitkubegateway \
  --namespace kube-system \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyReplacement=true \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyMode=none \
  --set straitd.image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
  --set sgController.image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
  --wait --timeout 300s
4 Verify Node Status & Dataplane 
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready nodes --all --timeout=180s
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app.kubernetes.io/name=straitkubegateway -o wide
💡
Kubeadm Dataplane Architecture Invariant
Bare-metal and VM clusters initialized via Kubeadm must skip the kube-proxy addon phase (--skip-phases=addon/kube-proxy). StraitKubeGateway's in-kernel eBPF dataplane provides complete, zero-overhead Service VIP routing, ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer translation, and full CNI networking without iptables or IPVS.
🏷️
Kubernetes Version Selector (v1.m.p)
Enter minor (m) & patch (p) to dynamically configure pkgs.k8s.io repository & kubeadm init
v1 . .
1 Host Networking & Kernel Preparation 
sudo swapoff -a
sudo sed -i '/ swap / s/^\(.*\)$/#\1/g' /etc/fstab
sudo modprobe overlay && sudo modprobe br_netfilter

cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/k8s.conf
net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables  = 1
net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-ip6tables = 1
net.ipv4.ip_forward                 = 1
EOF
sudo sysctl --system
2 Install Container Runtime Interface (containerd v2.3.4) 
# Download & unpack containerd v2.3.4
curl -LO https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/download/v2.3.4/containerd-2.3.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz
sudo tar Cxzvf /usr/local containerd-2.3.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz

# Install systemd service unit
curl -LO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/containerd/containerd/main/containerd.service
sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/systemd/system/
sudo mv containerd.service /usr/local/lib/systemd/system/

# Configure containerd with SystemdCgroup enabled
sudo mkdir -p /etc/containerd
containerd config default | sudo tee /etc/containerd/config.toml
sudo sed -i 's/SystemdCgroup \= false/SystemdCgroup \= true/g' /etc/containerd/config.toml
3 Install runc (v1.5.1) & Configure crictl (v1.36.0) 
# Download & install runc v1.5.1
curl -LO https://github.com/opencontainers/runc/releases/download/v1.5.1/runc.amd64
sudo install -m 755 runc.amd64 /usr/local/sbin/runc

# Download & configure crictl v1.36.0 for containerd
curl -LO https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cri-tools/releases/download/v1.36.0/crictl-v1.36.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz
sudo tar zxvf crictl-v1.36.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin
sudo crictl config runtime-endpoint unix:///var/run/containerd/containerd.sock

# Reload systemd and enable containerd CRI
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now containerd

# Verify containerd service status and crictl
sudo systemctl status containerd --no-pager
sudo crictl info
4 Install Reference CNI Plugins & CNI Configuration 
# Download & install standard CNI plugins (ptp, host-local, loopback, portmap)
CNI_PLUGINS_VERSION="v1.6.2"
sudo mkdir -p /opt/cni/bin
curl -LO "https://github.com/containernetworking/plugins/releases/download/${CNI_PLUGINS_VERSION}/cni-plugins-linux-amd64-${CNI_PLUGINS_VERSION}.tgz"
sudo tar -Cxzvf /opt/cni/bin "cni-plugins-linux-amd64-${CNI_PLUGINS_VERSION}.tgz"

# Create StraitKubeGateway CNI configuration directory
sudo mkdir -p /etc/cni/net.d
# (straitd automatically manages 10-strait.conflist and attaches eBPF hooks)
5 Install Kubelet, Kubeadm & Kubectl (Dynamic v1.m.p) 
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y apt-transport-https ca-certificates curl gpg
sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/Release.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/kubernetes-apt-keyring.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/kubernetes-apt-keyring.gpg] https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/ /" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kubernetes.list
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y kubelet=1.32.0-* kubeadm=1.32.0-* kubectl=1.32.0-*
sudo apt-mark hold kubelet kubeadm kubectl
6 Initialize Control Plane & Configure Kubeconfig 
sudo kubeadm init \
  --kubernetes-version=v1.32.0 \
  --pod-network-cidr=10.18.0.0/16 \
  --apiserver-advertise-address=192.168.56.3 \
  --skip-phases=addon/kube-proxy \
  --node-name master \
  --ignore-preflight-errors=NumCPU,Mem

# Prepare kubeconfig for kubectl
sudo chmod 755 /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf
export KUBECONFIG=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf

mkdir -p $HOME/.kube
sudo cp -i /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf $HOME/.kube/config
sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) $HOME/.kube/config

# Untaint control-plane so StraitKubeGateway CNI can schedule
kubectl taint nodes --all node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane- || true
7 Join Worker Nodes to the Cluster (Multi-Node) 
# Run on each worker node to join the cluster:
sudo kubeadm join 192.168.56.3:6443 \
  --token <token> \
  --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:<hash>

# In case you need to regenerate the join command on the master node:
kubeadm token create --print-join-command
8 Apply Gateway API CRDs & Install StraitKubeGateway via Helm 
# 1. Apply Gateway API v1.6.1 CRDs
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f \
  https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.6.1/standard-install.yaml

# 2. Deploy StraitKubeGateway eBPF CNI & Transit Gateway
helm repo add straitkubegateway https://msaeedb40.github.io/straitKubegateway
helm repo update

helm install straitkubegateway straitkubegateway/straitkubegateway \
  --namespace kube-system \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyReplacement=true \
  --set straitd.kubeProxyMode=none \
  --set straitd.wireguard.enabled=true \
  --wait --timeout 300s
9 Verify Bare-Metal Node & Workload Health

kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready nodes --all --timeout=180s
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app.kubernetes.io/name=straitkubegateway -o wide
kubectl get gatewayclasses,gateways,straitnetworks

sg-cli node

💻 Terminal Control Center

sg-cli: Command-Line Management Tool

The official command-line toolkit for inspecting node networking, tracing zero-trust policy evaluations, managing transit segments, and live kernel troubleshooting.

INSTALL sg-cli (amd64 / arm64)
Automated installer script with platform auto-detection for Linux (amd64, arm64) & macOS:
# 1. One-Line Auto Installer (Detects Linux/macOS & amd64/arm64)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msaeedb40/straitKubegateway/developer/scripts/sg-cli/install.sh | bash

# 2. Or run directly from cloned repository:
./scripts/sg-cli/install.sh

# 3. Direct Download (Linux amd64)
# curl -fsSL https://github.com/msaeedb40/straitKubegateway/releases/latest/download/sg-cli-linux-amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/sg-cli && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sg-cli

# 4. Direct Download (Linux arm64 / Apple Silicon / Graviton)
# curl -fsSL https://github.com/msaeedb40/straitKubegateway/releases/latest/download/sg-cli-linux-arm64 -o /usr/local/bin/sg-cli && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sg-cli

# 5. Or build via Go Toolchain
# go install github.com/msaeedb40/straitKubegateway/cmd/sg-cli@latest

🏗️ Core Architecture

Engineered for Zero Overhead

Six architectural pillars delivering uncompromised throughput, hardware offload capabilities, and zero cloud-vendor lock-in.

⚡

Native eBPF Dataplane

XDP, TCX, and NetKit hooks in Linux kernel 6.7+ bypass conntrack and iptables bottlenecks completely, operating with zero-copy buffer handoffs.

XDP TCX BPF CO-RE
⚖️

Kube-Proxy Replacement

Full Maglev consistent hashing with lookup tables for NodePort, ClusterIP, and LoadBalancer services with Direct Server Return (DSR).

Maglev-128 DSR Mode Zero-Conntrack
🌐

Multi-Cluster Transit Hub

Segment 0 backbone gateway facilitating cross-cluster routing with 32-bit segment IDs (0 to 4,294,967,295) for strict multi-tenant isolation.

Segment Routing Multi-Mesh BGP Peering
🛡️

Built-in NetKit CNI

CNI Spec 1.1+ compliant pod allocation utilizing Linux NetKit interfaces to eliminate traditional veth context switches and copy cycles.

NetKit veth Dynamic IPAM Dual-Stack

Zero-Trust Encryption

🗺️ Project Lifecycle

Production Release Roadmap

Progressive implementation phases from low-level Linux CO-RE kernel compilation to multi-cloud enterprise transit fabrics.

01

Core Dataplane & CNI

Kernel 6.7+ NetKit veth replacement, XDP/TCX packet filters, and dynamic IPAM pod interface provisioning.

✓ Completed (v1.0.0)
02

Transit Hub & BGP

Segment 0 backbone routing, 32-bit segment attachment policies, and sub-second BFD route peering.

✓ Completed (v1.0.1)
03

WireGuard Mesh Crypto

In-kernel peer-to-peer overlay encryption, dynamic key exchange, and hardware cryptographic offload.

⚡ Active Development
04

Enterprise Observability

OpenTelemetry eBPF flow tracer, Prometheus exporter, and WebAssembly UI management plane.
